title: Copy
description: Make a copy of a column or a list of columns.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: Name of the input columns or columns.

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: Name of the output columns or columns.

parameters.name: if
parameters.description: Condition that determines whether the wrangle runs as a whole. Recipe variables may be referenced with `${variable}`.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: Filter rows before applying the wrangle using SQL-like criteria, such as `column1 = 123 OR column2 = 'abc'`.

parameters.name: where_params
parameters.description: Values used with `where` for parameterized criteria. Uses SQLite placeholder syntax such as `?` or `:name`.

guidance:
Create a copy of columns in a dataframe. ## Migrated examples #### Copying a Column With Input and Output ##### Recipe ```yaml wrangles: - copy: input: Product Data output: Product Data (copy) ```
##### Input Sample | Product Data | | --- | | SKF ball brg | | brg seal |
##### Output Sample | Product Data | Product Data (copy) | | --- | --- | | SKF ball bearing | SKF ball bearing | | bearing seal | bearing seal |
#### Copying a Column Express as a Dictionary ##### Recipe ```yaml wrangles: - copy: Product Data: Product Data (copy) ```
##### Input Sample | Product Data | | --- | | SKF ball brg | | brg seal |
##### Output Sample | Product Data | Product Data (copy) | | --- | --- | | SKF ball bearing | SKF ball bearing | | bearing seal | bearing seal |
